cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(PoissonReconSolver CXX)

# Standalone build recipe for the vendored PoissonRecon solver sources
# (Adaptive Multigrid Solvers v18.75). The compile flags mirror upstream
# COLMAP's colmap_poisson_recon target exactly (RELEASE define,
# -funroll-loops -ffast-math on non-MSVC, OpenMP when found, /bigobj on MSVC)
# so the poisson_mesher reconstruction output stays byte-identical with the
# upstream binary.

add_library(poisson_recon STATIC PoissonRecon.cpp SurfaceTrimmer.cpp)
# Windows NMC builds consume this library through an IMPORTED location whose
# Debug name is poisson_recond.lib (3rdparty/PoissonRecon/PoissonRecon.cmake);
# without the postfix CMake would emit a plain poisson_recon.lib for Debug and
# the Debug lane would resolve to the Release archive (or miss it entirely).
if(MSVC)
    set_target_properties(poisson_recon PROPERTIES DEBUG_POSTFIX "d")
endif()
target_compile_definitions(poisson_recon PRIVATE RELEASE)
target_include_directories(poisson_recon PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(poisson_recon PRIVATE -funroll-loops -ffast-math)
    find_package(OpenMP QUIET)
    if(OpenMP_CXX_FOUND)
        target_link_libraries(poisson_recon PRIVATE OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)
    endif()
else()
    target_compile_options(poisson_recon PRIVATE /bigobj)
endif()

install(TARGETS poisson_recon ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
